cards.title: B03a3 scope (internal/harness)
items: Part of B03-consultation-core split. Internal service-to-service surfaces: HarnessInternalController (29+ route decorators observed), ConsultationReadInternalController, ConsentInternalController.

Harness config/creds: policy, prompt-templates resolved, models resolve, MCP token, provider credential. Harness consultation ops: entities, assemble, draft, gate-decision, escalation (and related internal ops; verify full list in controller/OpenAPI-internal inventory).

Consultation read: POST internal/consultations/:consultationId/read validates declared paths/schema and audits paths (not values). Consent assert: POST internal/consent/assert returns non-throwing decision (allowed/reason/unavailable/grantId/expiresAt).

cards.title: Example input/output (representative)
items: Models resolve: GET /internal/harness/models/resolve?taskKey|slug (+ tenant/taskType context) -> resolved model/provider metadata for harness use.
Consultation read: body {runId,nodeId,paths[]} + X-Tenant-Id -> {values, readAt, schemaVersion}; 400 for unknown/undeclared paths, 404 for foreign/unknown run/consultation.

Consent assert: {tenantId, externalPatientId, purpose, scope?, consultationId?, toolName?} -> {allowed, reason?/unavailable?, grantId?, expiresAt?}. Non-HTTP callers use this to distinguish denial vs unavailable (R4).
Harness ops (entities/assemble/draft/gate-decision/escalation): internal DTOs + idempotency where applicable -> persisted operation results. Verify DTO schemas and idempotency semantics.

cards.title: Evidence, security, limitations
items: Repo https://github.com/ArcaAI/project-hope.git @ 8cb2e5e8e6bbddf5ee7c676782ebb5ad683c23a0. Controllers/services verified in local tree.

Security/internal: controllers are @ApiExcludeController/@Public with HarnessServiceTokenGuard (+ InternalTenantLockGuard where applied). X-Service-Token and tenant context requirements are evidenced in controller code; do not treat as public API.

Limitations: grouped endpoint nodes (harness-internal is large); full harness route inventory should be reconciled with controller/OpenAPI/internal docs; downstream registries (model/MCP/provider) are summarized; audit/PHI-safety behavior is implementation-specific and noted where explicit in code comments.
